observations: Large stacked pile of blue plastic barrels/drums, photographed from two angles.
Drums appear to be standard 200L-style plastic barrels with screw-cap bung openings on top.
Some drums show rust-colored staining and grime on the lids and sides, likely from metal bands/rings or prior liquid residue.
No brand, capacity marking, or model number is legible on any drum in either photo.
Watermark 'EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG' overlaid on photo 1, seller's business name, not a product identifier.
Photos show a bulk stock/warehouse pile, not a single clearly isolated unit being sold.
No photo shows the inside of a drum, a close-up of a cap/seal, or any leak test.

read_from: photo 1 close view of drum tops

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of liquid
claims.evidence: No photo shows a seal/leak test, interior condition, or confirms food-grade vs chemical-grade suitability; staining visible in photo 1 raises doubt about prior contents.

risks.risk: Drum may have cracks, warping, or structural damage not visible in a stacked pile shot
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the specific drum being sold, from base to top, showing no cracks or dents
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/cosmetic-condition-only, not guaranteed structurally sound

risks.risk: Cap/bung seal may be missing, stripped, or non-functional, affecting liquid-tightness
risks.proof: Close-up photo or clip of the cap being opened and closed on the specific unit sold
risks.if_unproven: priced as not leak-proof/not guaranteed sealed

risks.risk: Prior contents may have been chemical/industrial, making it unsuitable for food or potable liquid storage
risks.proof: Photo of any manufacturer stamp/label on the drum interior or base indicating prior use or food-grade rating

risks.risk: Buyer may not receive a specific identified drum; photos show a bulk pile, so actual unit condition is unknown
risks.proof: A photo of the single drum earmarked for this buyer, separated from the pile, with visible condition
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-condition drum visible in the pile (worst case)

risks.risk: Rust-colored staining could indicate a steel reinforcing ring/band that is rusted, weakening the rim
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rim/band area on the specific drum
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a potentially compromised rim

proof_requests: Clear photo of the single specific drum to be sold, separated from the pile.
Close-up of the cap/bung and threads showing it seals properly.
Photo or short clip of the inside of the drum (empty, clean, no residue).
Any visible capacity/manufacturer stamp on the drum body or base.
Confirmation (stamp or label) of food-grade vs industrial-grade plastic.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used plastic storage drum, but with no proof of seal integrity, interior cleanliness, or structural condition, it must be priced at worst case as a used, unverified-condition industrial drum.
